task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab the blue plastic stapler with silver metal with the left arm and place it right of the sleek rectangular phone.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住带有银色金属的蓝色塑料订书机，并将其放置在光滑的矩形手机的右侧。
